stem: A grower substantially increases potassium while source water and root-zone pH remain stable, then sees symptoms consistent with reduced magnesium availability. Which mechanism deserves investigation?
choices: Cation competition or nutrient imbalance associated with the potassium increase.
A guarantee that magnesium is absent from the fertilizer.
The idea that macronutrients never interact.
rationale: Nutrient availability and uptake can be influenced by interactions among cations; a large potassium change can be relevant when evaluating magnesium-like symptoms.
